_comment: P1 — does the perf substrate change STRENGTH, or only speed?
Arms are two BUILDS: `integrated` (claude/mid-turn-collision-logic-mkxurg) and
`perf-substrate` (claude/cluster-lookahead). Both run their shipped defaults.
THIS SPEC IS THE PRECEDENT FOR EVERY CROSS-BRANCH ARM THE PROGRAMME NOW RUNS,
and it ran clean: batch 20260827 paired 144 games across these two bundles
with 0 dropped and 0 pairing problems. Two arms from two different refs in one
paired sweep is what this harness is FOR — build-bot.sh resolves any ref to a
bundle, run-pair.js launches the arms at the same instant in separate
processes, and the pairing is by gameId afterwards. Under the branching ruling
of 20260830 the same two branches are now named by ROLE rather than nickname:
`integrated` is the VALIDATED BASELINE (arm name `baseline`) and
`perf-substrate` is the SEARCH-ARCHITECTURE FEATURE BRANCH (arm name
`search-arch`). Batch 2's P11 is the same shape at the current tips, and it is
that branch's merge decision. See docs/BRANCHING.md on the engine branch.
This is the question the whole substrate programme has deferred: W1/W2/W3 and
CL0 were measured as throughput, and a throughput change that moves the number
of plans a 2000ms budget can price is a STRENGTH change whether or not anyone
intended it. At 2000ms there is enough budget for that to show.
snake6 is the inert-roster null cell and mix-king is the headline. Run the A/A
null pair alongside (spec n0-aa-null) in the same batch, on the same box.
